_comment: Single source of truth for all thresholds. Read by pipeline/config.py and the dashboard.

demo._comment: Demo mode: one simulated 'day' every few seconds; windows shortened proportionally.

live_demo._comment: Live demo mode (pipeline/live.py): rest-window rule OFF, one reading per second, compared immediately. Alert = |dT| >= alert_c, same sign, on alert_consecutive_samples readings in a row.

arduino._comment: Live demo from the FootMonitor board (python -m pipeline.live). channels[i] = [foot, site] of thermistor T<i> (A0, A1, A2); edit to match the wiring. Readings older than stale_s are not shown.
